summary.text: Leylines are ancient, naturally occurring tributaries of magical energy that crisscross a landscape and can be used only by mages who detect them.

bio.text: They occur even in the urban byways of Ravnica.
Nissa learns to see them on Zendikar, mimicking Ashaya's gesture and seeing glowing leylines stream from her fingers.
She wove Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashed around the titans, and sent the mana of all Zendikar through Chandra, who ignited the leylines.
At Thraben, Emrakul's arrival redirected the plane's lines of energy that the plan depended on.

status.text: Leylines remain a feature of planes, with the latest mention showing Nissa still perceiving and manipulating them on Zendikar in 2016.
